about: P1 Explain's recorded cases (PHASE8_PLAN 13.6 and the sprint's item 9: every Analyst task's cases include healthy baselines that must report nothing wrong, P1 Explain's first). Each case is a replay of a past window (scripts/nmas-pack-replay, the product's own pack as of the alert's time); cases.explain_unready says first whether the pack holds what the case is judged on, then cases.explain_misses judges the answer on structured fields. A healthy baseline passes on Explain's no fault found assessment, citing the healthy evidence it checked (C1742, the operator's ruling of 2026-10-25). What only a person can judge in the prose is the case's flag, read on the recording. Not yet recorded: no case holds a pack or an answer.

cases.name: C1547: the Lab 9 OSPF drops, a shared cause beneath the devices
cases.judge: judge Explain on honest reasoning at the edge of its evidence, not on naming the host's 96%: it must tie the routers' OSPF drops to s3's symptoms (heartbeat gaps, failed scrapes, discards), note s3's own CPU peaked at 57% so the device doesn't explain itself, offer resource contention beneath s3 (host/hypervisor or link) as an unevidenced hypothesis with what would confirm it, and never invent a figure. A confident 's3 CPU overload' is a fail. (the operator, 2026-10-25)
cases.revised: The pack shows every router's CPU peaking near 08:12 (r1 66, r2 67, r4 71, r6 67) and failed scrapes everywhere: a shared-host signature, which is the real cause. An answer citing those simultaneous peaks as a common cause beneath is better than one pinned on s3 (57%, the lowest). (the operator, 2026-10-25, after reading the replay's pack)
cases.ruled: Replace the s3-centred check with: ties r1's drop to its neighbour s4's symptoms (heartbeat gap, failed scrape), offers a shared cause beneath (host/hypervisor) as a hedged hypothesis citing cross-device evidence (scrape failures, heartbeat gaps or CPU peaks across devices), invents no figure. (the operator, 2026-10-26, replacing the judge and the revision above, which stay as this case's history)
cases.flag: A person reads the recording for what the structured fields cannot show: that the shared cause is offered beneath the devices (the host or the hypervisor), hedged as not in the evidence; that the drop is tied to s4's symptoms in words, not only by citation; and that no figure is stated the pack does not hold beyond percentages, which the judge checks.
